display.title: Massive stock market data API
display.summary: Use a Massive API key to query U.S. stock trades, OHLC aggregates, unified snapshots, and ticker reference data; availability depends on the data plan.

documentation.stabilityNote: Officially documented. Callers must use their own Massive account, API key, and market-data entitlements. Hub forwards a request only after explicit execution and does not cache, persist, or redistribute responses.

pricing.summary: Individual stock-data plans include Basic at $0/month and paid tiers at $29, $79, and $199/month; business use has separate plans.
pricing.freeTier: Stocks Basic is $0/month with 5 API calls per minute, two years of history, and end-of-day data.

credentials.description: Massive API key supplied through a Bearer header and retained only in the caller session.
